author: theboxplymouth
title: Artist Commission for Tides & Tales Heritage Project
content: OPPORTUNITY CALLOUT: ARTIST COMMISSION 🌊🎙️📦 @take_a_part_uk are looking for an artist-producer (or collective) to lead 'Tides & Tales', a multidisciplinary arts and heritage project for the East End community of Plymouth, capturing the histories of the working class fishing and ocean working area through intergenerational practices. They are seeking support in co-creating a podcast series and a 'Living Museum' cabinet with the East End community of Plymouth. Funded by @heritagefunduk with support from The Box. Key Info: Total Commission: £16,000 (£12,000 artist fee @ £300/day for 40 days + £4,000 materials/production). Location: East End of Plymouth. Delivery Window: November 2026 – March 2027. EOI Deadline: Friday 23 October 2026. Requirements: 5+ years of socially engaged, collaborative practice; High-quality audio/podcast production skills; Experience in 3D design, fabrication, or curation. How to apply: Send your CV, a 2-page outline proposal, and work samples to kim@takeapart.org.uk by 23 October.
